issues.title: OAuth2 redirect loop on staging environment
issues.description:
### 📌 Overview
When logging in via SSO on staging, the server loops endlessly between /auth/callback and /login due to missing CORS headers.

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Launch staging web portal.
2. Click "Sign in with SSO".
3. Observe endless browser redirect loops.

### 🎯 Expected Result
Redirects to /dashboard with JWT token.

### ⚠️ Actual Result
401 Unauthorized CORS preflight error.

comments.body: Inspected network logs. Header Access-Control-Allow-Origin is set to wildcard instead of staging domain.

issues.title: Missing ActivityLog for bulk status updates
issues.description:
### 📌 Overview
Bulk editing issues through the table view fails to insert audit trail records in PostgreSQL.

### 🔁 Steps to Reproduce
1. Select 3 issues on Kanban.
2. Click "Bulk Move to In Review".
3. Check activity_logs DB table.

### 🎯 Expected Result
Audit records generated for each transition.
